newsitem.title: THAILAND: Lanna Lignite to invest 2.85 bln baht power plant.
newsitem.headline: Lanna Lignite to invest 2.85 bln baht power plant.

text.p: Thai energy firm, Lanna Lignite, announced on Tuesday that it would invest 2.85 billion baht ($109 million) on the building of a cogeneration power plant.

The company will finance the project by borrowing 2.1 billion baht and the rest will be raised through the issue of fresh equity, the company said in a statement sent to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
The plant will be built by Lanna's unit Gulf Cogeneration Co. Ltd in which the firm holds 50 percent stake.
Gulf Cogeneration has recently signed a contract to sell 90 megawatts of electricity generated from the plant to the state-run Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT) for 21 years.
The plant, with full capacity of 107 megawatts, will be built in Saraburi, north of Bangkok. The remaining capacity will be sold to factories around the area.
It will soon sign an agreement to buy natural gas from the Petroleum Authority of Thailand as fuel for the project, the statement said.
